models_evaluated: voxel-level trained 3D multiparametric transrectal ultrasound AI model (AUROC 0.87)

links.outcome: Patient-level AI sensitivity and specificity in internal versus external evaluation datasets
links.effect: Internal (n=250): sensitivity 0.82, specificity 0.43 for ISUP ≥2. External (n=77): sensitivity 0.81, specificity 0.42 for ISUP ≥2. ISUP ≥3 sensitivity 0.90 internal vs 0.96 external.
links.quote: The AI model based on 3D mpUS showed consistent patient-level performance for csPCa detection in internal and external evaluation, comparable to voxel-level analysis.

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic performance and generalizability of an imaging AI model via simulated targeted biopsies on retrospective internal and external datasets without testing a deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
